# neocloud_block_storage (Resource)

A block storage volume. `size_gib` can only grow (shrink is rejected upstream). `image_id` and `snapshot_id` are mutually exclusive.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `pricing_id` (String)
- `size_gib` (Number)
- `zone_id` (String)

### Optional

- `attached_machine_id` (String)
- `dr` (Boolean)
- `image_id` (String)
- `snapshot_id` (String)
- `tags` (Map of String)
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)
